units.source_text: “我的话没有那么深奥，我每天嘎嗒嘎嗒地操作织机，没想过这么高深的问题。”

en.t: "What I said is not that profound. Every day I clatter away at the loom, and I have never thought about such lofty questions."

units.source_text: 秀男说着低下了头，“不过，比如说吧，令爱千重子小姐要是站在中宫寺或者广隆寺的弥勒佛爷前面，

en.t: Hideo said this and lowered his head. "But, for example, if your daughter, Miss Chieko, were to stand before the Maitreya Buddha at Chuguji or Koryuji,

units.source_text: 她不知要比佛爷美多少倍呢！”

en.t: who knows how many times more beautiful she would be than the Buddha!"
